digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities override table (Bedrock and Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but claude-opus-4-8 (rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL) and both global.* prefixes are also affected and lack guards, causing hard 400 errors when temperature is configured

Temperature rejection on opus models is family-wide (opus-4-8, opus-4-7) and prefix-aware (both us. and global.), but the override table keys on exact model id, leaving both prefixes unguarded unless both are listed explicitly

The Anthropic adapter (models/anthropic.py:641) silently drops temperature on claude-opus-4-8 and warns, while the Bedrock adapter has no such drop and fails with ValidationException, creating a two-symptom single defect across both provider paths

Pass-2 code-review verification pins temperature=0 for determinism, but on Anthropic it silently resamples because claude-opus-4-8's capability override was missing, making greedy decoding unverifiable in production

Temperature rejection is not 'unsupported' but 'explicit non-default sampling rejected' — temp=1.0 (API default) succeeds while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, confirming the parameter must be withdrawn entirely not just conditionally

The top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus models (confirmed by CloudTrail) and currently latent because rebar never sets it, but no supports_top_p guard exists and the gap becomes live if sampling parameters are extended
